svg.text: Cabinet weldment (shell, top, base, door, back panel, HMI pod, backing plate)
Column weldment (tube, base plate, cap, horseshoe)
Drive head (head plate, spindle cartridge + spacers, agitator hub, bridge, guards)
Container stage (plate, rods, bushings, pin bar, plunger block, sensor bracket)
Bearings, belt drive, chain drive, seals
Safety and electrical parts, feet, cabinet hardware, clamps
208 V 1-ph 20 A 2-pole circuit, cord to Q1 on the cabinet
scoop from the released drum into the port at 1,632 AFF
to the capper bench at 905 AFF
Modbus TCP: counts, faults, recipe (PLC port 1)
1. All dimensions mm [in]. Third-angle projection. Stage shown at the jar-12 stop; container phantom. Feet set to 60 [2.36] (±25 [1]); level the top ±0.5° before setting the tooling.
2. Auger drive: servo P1-413 → HTD belt 2:1 → spindle (2 x 6205) → auger on M16 LH thread. Agitator: gearmotor P1-414 → #40 chain 2:1 → hub (2 x 6009) at 30 rpm.
3. Hopper 42 L (23 kg of blend) hangs on the horseshoe by its rim angle, 2 locating pins; it slides out forward after the auger and agitator are off (P1-401-003).
4. Guarding: belt and chain guards fixed (tools); scoop flap interlocked (B1) with the agitator and the servo STO through the safety relay; container sensor blocks a dose with no container.
